recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in a black suit and fedora stands on a wooden pier that recedes into a city skyline at dusk. The sky is a gradient of purple and pink, reflected in the water below. The composition uses strong diagonal lines from the pier railings to draw the eye toward the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between converging diagonal perspective lines
Dark silhouette of the figure against a vibrant purple-to-orange sky
Urban skyline framing the mid-ground behind the subject
coreInvariants: Purple and orange dusk color palette
Wide-angle perspective with low horizon line
Subject wearing formal black attire with a hat
Wooden pier structure providing leading lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and gold chain at the upper-center intersection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left text, follows the diagonal pier railings down to the bottom-right text, then returns to the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the upper quadrants and water in the lower-left quadrant provide breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and violet in the sky and reflections.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the subject's suit and the pier structure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and yellow from the city lights and sunset horizon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky tones against low-value, high-contrast black foreground elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and rounded display faces
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extra-bold, wide-set sans-serif with high horizontal stress
Bottom text: Rounded, bubbly display font with thick outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Integration of a stylized currency symbol or icon between words in the top line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, geometric header and a soft, organic sub-header.
graphicDevices: Thick white outlines on bottom text
Central icon separator in top text

preserve: The purple/white color scheme for the bottom text
The wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, bold presence of the top display text
Captures the rounded, friendly but bold nature of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a black suit and fedora standing on a wooden pier at dusk. The pier recedes into the distance towards a city skyline. The sky is a vibrant gradient of purple and orange. The water reflects the sky and city lights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a wide-set, bold white sans-serif title at the top center. Apply a three-line stacked, rounded purple display font with a thick white outline in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a purple-to-orange gradient?
Are the diagonal lines of the pier leading to the subject?
Is the bottom text outlined in white?
Is the subject wearing a black fedora?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the purple reflection in the water
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + receding pier perspective + urban dusk skyline + high-contrast bold typography.
